stats.text: As a {ref:glossary/magic} action, you can expend one use of this class's Channel Divinity to overwhelm foes with awe. As you present your {ref:equipment/holy-symbol} or weapon, you can target a number of creatures equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one creature) that you can see within 60 feet of yourself. Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the {ref:condition/frightened} condition for 1 minute or until it takes any damage. While {ref:condition/frightened} in this way, a target can do only one of the following on its turns: move, take an action, or take a {ref:glossary/bonus-action}.
